parameters.name: DisplayName
parameters.description: The display name of the code configuration. Fuzzy match is supported.

parameters.name: Order
parameters.description:
The sort order for the specified field in a paged query. Valid values:
- ASC (default): ascending order.
- DESC: descending order.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number of the code configuration list. Minimum value: 1. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: SortBy
parameters.description:
The field used for sorting. Valid values:
- GmtModifyTime: the time when the code source was last modified.
- DisplayName: the display name.
- CodeSourceId: the code source ID.
- GmtCreateTime (default): the time when the code source was created.

parameters.name: WorkspaceId
parameters.description: The workspace ID. This parameter is required. For information about how to obtain the workspace ID, see [ListWorkspaces](~~449124~~).
